newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank bought $4.298 bln this year.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank bought $4.298 bln this year.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Monday its net dollar purchases reached a net of $4.298 billion since the start of the year up to October 4.
These brought up its dollar reserves to a record $11.5 billion, 48 percent up from the end-1995 level of $7.77 billion, the Central Bank said.

To date, the Central Bank accounted for 35 percent of the total deals of $17.129 billion on the Philippine Dealing System, the official market for peso-dollar trading. It had purchases of $5.174 billion and sales of $876 million since January. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
